about: Draft audit of a fictional company with planted mistakes. The verifier passes when it reports every planted mistake against the right finding or play ID, and does not list a correct finding under Must fix.

planted.mistake: The stated window is 2026Q2 to 2026Q4, but 32.9% (280 of 850) uses all eight quarters, across the definition break. The window figure is 30.0% (180 of 600).
The Health rate is given as 56% with no counts. It is 55.6% (75 of 135).
Retail is 0 of 6 decided deals in the window. A rate from six deals cannot carry an ICP decision, and the finding shows no counts.
No direct deal in the window has two buyer roles, so the pattern is not shown on direct deals. It holds on partner deals only.
The finding carries no status label.
The pricing capture shows prices for Starter ($900 a month) and Growth ($2,400 a month). Only Enterprise says Contact sales.

The by-source report has no opportunity ID and covers all eight quarters, so its 32.9% cannot be compared with the 30.0% window rate. In the window, inbound is 30.0% (90 of 300), the same as outbound.
Play 1 has no volume line and no capacity line.
The expected lift is taken from a third-party benchmark. A benchmark supports the mechanism and never becomes the company's expected lift.
The capture says 1.6 times, published 2024, an analysis of closed opportunities. The draft says 2.4 times, 2025, survey.

controls.note: Enterprise 40.0% (120 of 300) and SMB 20.0% (60 of 300) are correct.
Four of six named customers are hospitals or health systems, as the capture shows.
300 of 420 lost deals in the window left from Qualify. 71.4% is correct.
210 of 420 losses are no decision; 84 each for price and competitor; 180 of 558 without duplicates is 32.3%. All correct.

pass_rule: Every planted mistake is reported under Must fix or Should fix with its ID, and no control ID appears under Must fix.
